description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Twin Element Mode II (Wind, Poison)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode I (Marcus)] and [Wind/Poison Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode I (Marcus)
description.text: Wind and Poison abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Poison abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =50/100% for Wind and Poison abilities after casting 1/2+ Wind and Poison abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode II (Marcus)], removes [Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode I (Marcus)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode II (Marcus)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Wind and Poison abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Wind Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Wind Ability +20% Boost 1]/[Wind Ability +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using 1/2/3+ abilities that deal Wind damage, grants [Poison Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Poison Ability +20% Boost 1]/[Poison Ability +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using 1/2/3+ abilities that deal Poison damage, grants [Buff Prismatic 10% (5s)] to all FF9 allies after using Wind or Poison abilities
